questions.question: Two planets A and B have same density but radii R and 2R respectively. The ratio of escape velocities from their surfaces is:
questions.explanation: Escape velocity Ve = R * sqrt(8πGρ/3). Since ρ is same, Ve ∝ R.

hi.explanation: पलायन वेग Ve = R * sqrt(8πGρ/3)। चूंकि ρ समान है, इसलिए Ve ∝ R।

questions.explanation: Inside a solid sphere, V = -GM(3R^2 - r^2) / 2R^3.

hi.explanation: एक ठोस गोले के अंदर, V = -GM(3R^2 - r^2) / 2R^3 होता है।

questions.question: The escape velocity from the surface of a planet of mass M and radius R is Ve. If both M and R are doubled, the escape velocity will:
questions.explanation: Ve = sqrt(2GM/R). If both M and R are doubled, the ratio M/R remains constant.

questions.question: If the sun's mass were 10 times smaller and gravitational constant G were 10 times larger:

options.C: Walking on ground would be easier
options.D: Time period of simple pendulum increases

questions.explanation: Since G' = 10G, the local g on Earth would increase significantly (assuming Earth mass stays same), making objects fall faster.

hi.explanation: चूंकि G' = 10G, पृथ्वी पर स्थानीय g काफी बढ़ जाएगा (यह मानते हुए कि पृथ्वी का द्रव्यमान समान रहता है), जिससे वस्तुएं तेजी से गिरेंगी।

questions.question: In a satellite, the energy required to double its orbital radius is:
questions.explanation: Total energy E = -GMm/2r. To move from r to 2r, ΔE = -GMm/4r - (-GMm/2r) = GMm/4r = E/2 (magnitude).

hi.question: एक उपग्रह में, इसकी कक्षीय त्रिज्या को दोगुना करने के लिए आवश्यक ऊर्जा है:
hi.explanation: कुल ऊर्जा E = -GMm/2r। r से 2r तक जाने के लिए, ΔE = -GMm/4r - (-GMm/2r) = GMm/4r = E/2 (परिमाण)।

questions.question: If a body is thrown with 1.5 times the escape velocity, its speed at infinity will be:
questions.explanation: v_inf = sqrt(v^2 - Ve^2) = sqrt(1.5^2 - 1^2)Ve = sqrt(1.25)Ve ≈ 1.118 Ve.

hi.question: यदि किसी वस्तु को पलायन वेग के 1.5 गुना वेग से फेंका जाता है, तो अनंत पर उसकी गति होगी:
hi.explanation: v_inf = sqrt(v^2 - Ve^2) = sqrt(1.5^2 - 1^2)Ve = sqrt(1.25)Ve ≈ 1.118 Ve।
